readout: Complementation fitness of a yeast cys4-delta strain at low vitamin B6; higher is more functional
assay_method: Functional complementation of a Saccharomyces cerevisiae cys4-delta strain by human CBS, which restores growth without glutathione supplementation. A variant library made by POPCode mutagenesis was assayed in parallel and scored by the authors' TileSeq framework, at low and high vitamin B6 to read out B6 remediability. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit, using the raw score sets rather than the imputed and refined ones.
remark: Of the deposit's 11478 rows, 411 nonsense rows are dropped, a premature stop not being writable as a substitution, and 3333 rows collapse into 2355 duplicate groups whose members are the same protein variant reached by different codons and whose spread is exactly zero in every group. The 517 synonymous rows are the wild-type protein and collapse to the single WT row at their mean, whose worst spread is 1.520. The raw score set is used; the deposit's imputed-and-refined sets for the same condition are not curated, imputed values being computed rather than measured. The article is open access but neither Europe PMC's fullTextPDF route nor the publisher's counter/pdf link returns a PDF to an automated request, so it is not redistributed in papers/.

readout: Complementation fitness of a yeast serine-auxotroph strain depending on human PSAT1, by solid growth assay, on a scale where wild type reads about 1; higher is more functional
assay_method: Functional complementation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, exploiting the conservation of phosphoserine aminotransferase in the serine biosynthesis pathway: human PSAT1 must substitute for the yeast orthologue for cells to grow, read out by a solid growth assay. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit urn:mavedb:00000107.
remark: LICENCE: this dataset is derived from data licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/), unlike every other MaveDB-derived dataset in this repository, which is CC0. Redistribution must keep attribution to Sirr A, Lo RS, Cromie GA, Scott AC, Ashmead J, Heyesus M, Dudley AM. and to MaveDB urn:mavedb:00000107, must not be for commercial purposes, and any adaptation of this dataset must itself carry CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. See DATA_LICENSES.md. The sequence is UniProt Q9Y617 exactly, 370 aa, and every label verifies against it. The deposit's two score sets are joined into one dataset because they are the same assay measuring the same quantity on overlapping libraries: 196 variants are measured in both and are averaged, and their agreement is the only empirical check the merge gets -- Pearson r = 0.9708, worst disagreement 0.256. No value is identical between the two, so they are independent measurements rather than a reupload. 3 frameshift rows are dropped, an indel having no {WT}{position}{MUT} form. Neither set carries a wild-type or synonymous row, so wt_readout is empty and the zero point of normalized-score is the dataset mean, though the scale is one on which wild type reads about 1.
